newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Feb manufacturing output up 5.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Feb manufacturing output up 5.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 3.7 percent in February compared with January, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.
February manufacturing production was 5.9 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Feb 97 Jan 97 Feb 96
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
NOTES - Economists' consensus forecast for February manufacturing production was a rise of 3.7 per cent year-on-year and a rise of 2.5 percent month-on-month.
The CBS had reported last month that January manufacturing production rose 0.5 percent year-on-year but fell 3.4 percent month-on-month.

Today it said the average volume of Dutch manufacturing production during the first two months of 1997 was roughly the same as in the preceding months but 3.7 percent higher than in the first two months of 1996 when output was exceptionally low.
